model_context: This is an isolated synthetic portfolio as of 2026-10-08. Use the provided skill and fixed offline scripts. Public evidence is available via python research/public_reader.py SOURCE RESOURCE --symbol US.SYMBOL. Read-only resources: futu company-profile, financials, estimates, quote, headlines; filing earnings-release, segments, company-calendar, article. The market-wide economic calendar uses futu economic-calendar without --symbol. The earnings calendar uses futu calendar --start YYYY-MM-DD --end YYYY-MM-DD (at most seven inclusive days). Each symbol request uses one public symbol. No network or other accounts. Return the user-facing portfolio report.

US.NXCC.management_commentary: Two customers moved some delivery acceptance from Q3 to Q4 because grid connections were delayed. The full-year revenue range was maintained.

US.LNKF.management_commentary: Switch shipments track customer cluster turn-on dates. Service revenue rose 18%; service contracts represented 21% of quarterly revenue.

US.WATR.management_commentary: Utilities and factories account for more than half of revenue. Project conversion is exposed to permitting; deposits cover 20% of the datacenter backlog.

US.LUMC.management_commentary: Commissioning slippage delayed recognized revenue. Eighty percent of contracted backlog is noncancellable, but customers can shift commencement by up to six months.

US.THMS.management_commentary: Liquid cooling wins offset slower conventional equipment shipments. The largest customer accounts for 24% of revenue; warranty accrual rose from 1.1% to 2.0% of sales.

US.GRID.management_commentary: Utility replacement demand is independent of new datacenter construction; datacenter orders nonetheless carry higher margins. Copper input costs rose 9% year over year.

US.NOVS.management_commentary: Infrastructure customers slowed seat growth; automation usage increased. Product gross margin improved, but sales compensation amortization also declined.
